items.title: Game Reskinning Explained: Cost, Risks and Store Rules
items.en_title: Game Reskinning Explained: Cost, Risks and Store Rules
items.en_oneliner: A reskin swaps art, sound and branding while keeping the gameplay, costing roughly $500-$3,000 for a basic job; the author breaks down three cost tiers, when it makes sense, and why Apple and Google treat bulk reskins as spam.

items.title: "Don't let this happen again": GTA 6 hacker who pleaded guilty to 2022 Rockstar Games breach released under supervision
items.en_title: "Don't let this happen again": GTA 6 hacker who pleaded guilty to 2022 Rockstar Games breach released under supervision
items.en_oneliner: Arion Kurtaj, who pleaded guilty to the 2022 Rockstar breach that leaked GTA 6 footage, has been released under supervision with a five-year serious crime prevention order restricting his online activity.

items.title: Running a C++ MMORPG client in the browser (and on iPhone) with WebAssembly
items.en_title: Running a C++ MMORPG client in the browser (and on iPhone) with WebAssembly
items.en_oneliner: The author compiled the same C++ client to WebAssembly with Emscripten and bridged WebSocket to TCP, so the Tibia private-server client runs install-free in Chrome, Safari on iPhone, and even the Xbox browser.
